title: A covariance-based reduced-order framework for solving acoustic scattering problems
summary: This paper presents a physics-aware reduced-order method (ROM) for the efficient computation of wave-scattering problems. Standard model order reduction techniques, typically treating scattering as generic parameterized systems, frequently overlook the underlying physical structure, limiting their effectiveness in practice. To address this limitation, we propose an algorithmic framework that utilizes the intrinsic low-rank structure of the induced contrast source density.
